hypothesis: The causal near-ATM put-call skew (skew) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with subsequent forward vol-of-vol (std of squared log returns) of the BTC/ETH perpetual, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor.
extends: EVAL-71 (same skew surface signal and floor; different forward target: vol-of-vol vs RV)

protocol.title: Options near-ATM put-call skew (skew) -> forward vol-of-vol / variance-of-variance predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (same skew surface signal and sealed EVAL-71 floor; distinct forward target: vol-of-vol = std(squared log returns) vs RV = sqrt(mean(squared returns)))
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-71; does not re-litigate EVAL-71/84/85/86/87/95
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM put-call skew skew (mean put iv - mean call iv over near-ATM option trades over the trailing window) from the real option trade tape, forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71.build_surface_bars/e71._forward_fill/e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: forward vol-of-vol = sqrt(mean((v_i - mean(v))^2)) where v_i = r_i^2 are squared log returns over bars k+1..k+H (reused e84._forward_vov; distinct from forward RV)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, vov_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (richer/more positive skew -> higher forward vol-of-vol)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
